title: Verdure Sciences, Inc. — Warning Letter (Drugs/CDER)
ai_summary: FDA Warning Letter 원문 기준, Verdure Sciences, Inc.는 Maplifa® 임상시험 Protocol 005를 IND 제출·발효 없이 시작했고, CRO 계약에도 sponsor 의무 이전 범위가 명시되지 않았습니다. FDA는 해당 시험이 의약품 임상시험이며 IND 면제 요건을 충족하지 않는다고 보아, 향후 임상시험의 IND 판단·제출과 위탁업체 책임관리 절차 보완을 요구했습니다.

summary_review.method: Codex GPT 요약 + 원문 근거 문구 자동 일치 검사
summary_review.scope: 개별 FDA Warning Letter 공식 페이지에서 추출·보관한 본문을 검토했습니다.

change_summary: FDA Warning Letter 원문 기준, Verdure Sciences, Inc.는 Maplifa® 임상시험 Protocol 005를 IND 제출·발효 없이 시작했고, CRO 계약에도 sponsor 의무 이전 범위가 명시되지 않았습니다. FDA는 해당 시험이 의약품 임상시험이며 IND 면제 요건을 충족하지 않는다고 보아, 향후 임상시험의 IND 판단·제출과 위탁업체 책임관리 절차 보완을 요구했습니다.

impact_summary.value: FDA는 Protocol 005에서 조사약이 의약품으로 사용됐다고 판단하고, 사전 IND 없이 임상시험을 시작한 것이 피험자의 안전·복지와 수집 데이터의 타당성·무결성에 우려를 제기한다고 밝혔다. 향후 임상시험에서도 IND 규정 준수를 확인할 수 있도록 충분한 절차·시정예방 계획을 제시하지 않았다고 지적했다.

evidence.quote: As a result, you were required to submit an IND before conducting the clinical investigation.

Verdure’s failure to submit, and to have in effect, an IND before initiating Protocol 005 with an investigational drug raises significant concerns about the safety and welfare of enrolled subjects, and raises concerns about the validity and integrity of the data collected during the conduct of this clinical investigation.

your written response is inadequate because it does not provide sufficient details of a corrective and preventive action plan for developing and implementing procedures that comply with IND regulations, should Verdure decide in the future to initiate another clinical investigation for which an IND is required.

affected_work.value: Verdure Sciences가 의뢰자 역할을 한 Maplifa® 임상시험 Protocol 005의 IND 제출·유지, 의뢰자 의무의 CRO 이전 문서화, 그리고 향후 IND가 필요한 임상시험의 규정 준수 절차가 대상이다.

evidence.quote: The investigators representing FDA reviewed the role of Verdure Sciences, Inc. (Verdure) as the sponsor of a clinical investigation (Protocol 005, “Randomized, Double-Blind Evaluation of Maple leaf extract (Maplifa for Photoaging”) of the investigational drug Maplifa® (1% or 5%).

Verdure failed to comply with these requirements. Specifically, Verdure initiated Protocol 005, a clinical investigation of the investigational drug Maplifa®, which is subject to section 505 of the FD&C Act [21 U.S.C. 355], without submitting and having in effect an IND.

Neither of these documents describes which of Verdure’s sponsor obligations for conducting this study, if any, were transferred to the third-party vendor. Additionally, the CSA and work order do not contain any general statements that sponsor obligations have been transferred.

recommendation.value: FDA는 향후 유사한 위반을 막기 위해 취한 조치를 서면으로 알리고, 향후 IND가 필요한 임상시험을 시작할 경우 관련 규정에 따르는 절차를 마련·이행하도록 요구했다. 규정을 준수했다고 판단한다면 그 근거와 자료를 함께 제출하도록 안내했다.

evidence.quote: Within 15 business days of your receipt of this letter, you should notify this office in writing of the actions you have taken to prevent similar violations in the future.

your written response is inadequate because it does not provide sufficient details of a corrective and preventive action plan for developing and implementing procedures that comply with IND regulations, should Verdure decide in the future to initiate another clinical investigation for which an IND is required.
If you believe that you have complied with the FD&C Act and relevant regulations, please include your reasoning and any supporting information for our consideration.
